preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of bus routes m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of questions q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < i for i in range(2, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each city connection p_i must be a valid city index less than i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in bus_routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must involve two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else str(min_buses)
postconditions.description: Output -1 if the cities are not reachable, otherwise output the minimum number of buses needed.

postconditions.expression: all(min_buses >= 1 for min_buses in results if min_buses != -1)
postconditions.description: The minimum number of buses used must be at least 1 for reachable cities.
The number of results must match the number of queries.
